name: How long does it take to clear a main sewer line blockage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to clear a main sewer line blockage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to clear a main sewer line blockage can vary. For straightforward clogs accessible with snaking, the process might take 1 to 3 hours. More complex issues, such as extensive tree root intrusion or significant buildup requiring hydro-jetting, could take several hours. If a sewer line needs repair due to damage, the timeline will extend. A professional plumber will assess the situation and provide an estimated completion time upon diagnosis.
